title: controlplane-huddle-july-01-2026
content:
Control plane weekly huddle — notes and actions (timeboxed: 30m)
Date: 2026-07-01
Facilitator: Maya Thompson
Attendees: Arjun, Sofia, Liam, Chen, Rhea, Maya (plus async updates from infra-oncall)

Purpose: quick sync across routing, auth, quotas; surface blockers and immediate actions. This is intentionally light on long-term design — capture flags and assign owners.

Agenda:
- Quick metrics (2 min)
- Incident follow-ups (5 min)
- Routing / quota / auth updates (15 min)
- Blockers & action items (5 min)
- Quick retrospec: what to change in huddle (3 min)

Summary metrics (morning snapshot):
- Control-plane API p95 latency: 280ms (target 250ms) — small regression vs last week during 03:00-05:00 UTC window.
- Auth token validation errors increased to 0.14% (typical 0.02%) between 03:30-04:10 UTC.
- Routing decision cache hit rate: 88% (goal 93%) — low due to rollout of routing-v2 on a subset of hosts.
- Quota throttles: 1200/min peak on Dedicated tier (expected at commit time spikes).

Incident follow-ups
- Brief: we had a short (~40m) increase in auth validation errors tied to a token rotation edge-case (PLAT-1457).
- Root cause: the rotation job wrote new keys to KMS but a subset of control-plane pods were still using an older KMS credentials cache; clock skew + stale cache led to validation mismatch for short-lived tokens.
- Action taken: rolled back rotation, forced cache invalidation across pods, deployed rotation fix PR (see linked PR).
- Postmortem owner: Arjun (target doc draft by 2026-07-04).
- Immediate mitigation: add a pre-rotation coordination step (see action items).

Routing update (Sofia)
- Progress: routing-v2 rollout to 20% of pods. Observed lower cache hit rate and slightly higher weigh calculation time (microseconds scale) for new rule engine.
- Observations: failed fallback to legacy routing happens if new rule-engine returns null for ambiguous inputs — need deterministic fallback code path.
- Work in flight: PR #498 adds explicit fallback and a feature-flag gate. Code review requested.
- Risk: if we continue fast-rollouts the cache pressure could increase tokenization cost (edge cases) — recommend backoff to 10% until fallback is merged.

Auth & Tokening (Chen)
- Rotation fix deployed to staging. Added a registration handshake to ensure pods fetch new KMS publish events before accepting rotated tokens.
- Proposal: implement a short-lived handshake TTL (30s) plus clock-skew tolerant verification. Preliminary numbers look good in staging.
- Next: schedule rotation for production during low-traffic window with coordinated drain (PLAT-1512).

Quotas & Throttling (Liam)
- Noted quota bursts from a Dedicated customer integration test. Quota system performed as designed but rate-limiting alarms were noisy.
- Plan: introduce a soft-prewarm path for traffic that spikes from known reserved pools (RFC draft linked in Confluence).
- Short term: silence noisy alerts by adding a suppression rule for known scheduled test windows. Owner: Liam (suppress rule live by 2026-07-03).

Blockers
- QA on routing-v2 fallback PR is queued (no SRE QA seat this week) — blocker for safe rollout. Owner: Sofia to coordinate with SRE and get a tester assigned (due 2026-07-02).
- Token rotation coordination flow needs small infra permission to access KMS audit logs; security review in progress. Owner: Chen to follow up with security (meeting scheduled 2026-07-02).

Decisions made during huddle
- Pause routing-v2 rollout at 20% until fallback PR merges and SRE validates (decision agreed).
- Adopt pre-rotation coordination step for KMS rotations: rotation will perform a rolling announce and wait for >=95% pod ack before cutting over.
- Suppress quota alerts for scheduled dedicated-customer-test windows; add postmortem requirement if suppression is used.

Action items (owner — due date)
1) Arjun — Draft incident postmortem for auth rotation (PLAT-1457) — 2026-07-04.
2) Sofia — Coordinate SRE QA for routing-v2 fallback PR, get approval or schedule remediation — 2026-07-02.
3) Chen — Finish security review input and request KMS permission change; confirm with security (meeting 7/2) — 2026-07-03.
4) Liam — Add suppression rule for quota-alert noise and update runbook with prewarm note — 2026-07-03.
5) Maya — Update huddle runbook to include a short incident triage checklist and add a rotating facilitator schedule — 2026-07-05.
6) Rhea — Start RFC for quota soft-prewarm path and link design notes to Confluence — 2026-07-06.

Open questions / parking lot
- How long should the pre-rotation handshake window be? (30s proposal — open for feedback)
- Should routing rollout gates include a cache warmup stage? (parking for next week)
- Metrics: consider adding a dedicated metric for KMS cache invalidations per pod to identify skew hotspots.

Notes-to-self / informal
- Quick checklist to add to rotation runbook: pre-announce -> ensure ACK >=95% -> rotate -> verify token acceptance -> monitor for 30m.
- Suggest we run a scheduled mini-chaos test for rotation in staging monthly.
- Huddle cadence: keep weekly but rotate facilitator; if incident spikes, switch to daily 15m for the affected subsystem.

Next huddle: 2026-07-08 (Tues) — Maya to facilitate unless reassigned.

Links referenced:
- Incident ticket: JIRA PLAT-1457
- Routing fallback PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/498
- Auth rotation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/732
- Confluence: Control Plane Huddle space

End of notes.
